name: Add ai search
description: The conversation involves modifying `chat_engine.py` to support a new `"search"` task mode. When a user message has `task_item == "search"`, the engine delegates to `KnowledgeAISearch.ai_search` instead of the normal AI chat flow. A new `_handle_search_task` async method handles the search, builds a response message with the AI-generated answer, and attaches distinct document source paths as the message's file list. The module-level constant `TASK_ITEM_SEARCH = "search"` was added for clarity, along with the necessary `KnowledgeAISearch` import. Additional code quality improvements include proper docstrings, `%`-style logging, and safer file handling throughout the class.

messages.content:
when task_item from the user request is "search" use knowledgeAI search with the user_message content.
